title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Frontend Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of high-impact features, mentor junior engineers, and drive best practices that ensure our sales analytics products scale with the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and optimize complex React applications and reusable component libraries
  • Lead technical design reviews and establish frontend coding standards across the team
  • Collaborate with product, UX, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, accessibility issues, and cross-browser inconsistencies
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Own release planning, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing strategies to maintain >90 % test coverage


Need to Haves

  • 5+ years of production experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance frontend solutions
  • Strong English skills – comfortable presenting technical decisions to stakeholders and writing detailed RFCs
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving technical excellence and mentoring teams


Nice to Haves

  • Deep domain expertise in sales or revenue analytics (CRM integrations, forecasting dashboards)
  • Experience building and governing enterprise-grade design systems or HEX component libraries
  • Proficiency with Next.js, GraphQL, and cloud-native deployment (AWS Amplify, Vercel, or similar)

description:

Jornada de Formação – Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI

A jornada é estruturada para acelerar o desenvolvimento técnico, comercial e estratégico do profissional, que desde o primeiro dia já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI.


  • 1º mês | Onboarding

  • 2º mês | Prospecção

  • 3º e 4º meses | Aquisição

  • Meses seguintes | Alocação e Consolidação

  • Ao longo de toda a jornada, o profissional conta com simulações comerciais com apoio de IA , suporte técnico especializado e fornecimento de leads para impulsionar o crescimento.


  • Evolução

Por que escolher a EQI?

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science



Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field


Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

title: Customer Service América Latina

Nosso portfólio de áudio profissional e comunicações críticas inclui marcas reconhecidas mundialmente, como Electro-Voice, Dynacord, RTS e Telex . A posição de Customer Service é fundamental para garantir uma excelente experiência ao cliente, apoiando todo o processo de vendas — desde a entrada do pedido, o faturamento e acompanhamento da entrega.

A função atua em parceria com as áreas de Vendas, Contabilidade, Controladoria e Contas a Receber, assegurando o processamento correto dos pedidos, entregas no prazo, comunicação clara e resolução eficaz de eventuais problemas.

  • Criar pedidos de venda no SAP para a América Latina (entrega FCA Miami)
  • Atuar como ponto de contato com as áreas de Contas a Receber e Crédito
  • Acompanhar entregas e rastrear o processo de vendas de ponta a ponta
  • Participar do planejamento de volumes de contêineres e acompanhar o envio até o destino
  • Gerar relatórios de entregas, status de pedidos e faturamento para clientes e Controladoria
  • Atender às solicitações e dúvidas dos clientes
  • Solicitar notas de crédito e débito quando aplicável
  • Reportar, acompanhar e apoiar na resolução de erros de entrega, oferecendo soluções paliativas quando aplicável.


O SEU PERFIL DEVE TER:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Comércio Exterior, Negócios Internacionais ou áreas similares
  • Experiência previa em Customer Service mínima de 5 anos
  • Conhecimento básico do sistema SAP (mínimo 1 ano desejável)
  • Perfil orientado a resultados, com foco em processos e eficiência
  • Facilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa e interdisciplinar
  • Espanhol avançado e Inglês intermediário
  • Interesse em aprendizado contínuo e melhoria de processos

title: Estagiário

Quem é a LiuGong Latin America?

description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and versatile ML Engineer to join our advanced analytics team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy recommendation systems, time series forecasting models, and machine learning solutions based on boosting and decision tree algorithms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to turn data into actionable insights and scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using traditional and machine learning techniques (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.)
  • Implement boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision trees for various supervised learning tasks
  • Collaborate with data engineers and ML engineers to deploy models on Azure and Databricks environments
  • Perform data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Present findings and models clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Stay up to date with the latest tools and methodologies in applied machine learning


Profile Requirement

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field
  • Proven experience with recommender systems and time series models
  • Strong knowledge of boosting algorithms and decision trees, C++
  • Proficiency in Python and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure cloud services and Databricks
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)

title: Auxiliar de Performance Comercial
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

• Realizar auditorias fiscais das operações;

Apoiar na interpretação de normas e orientações da Anatel.

Avaliar e aprovar projetos de outros membros.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science

Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field

Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

title: Auxiliar de Performance Comercial
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

• Realizar auditorias fiscais das operações;

title: SDR
description:
SDR (Inbound & Outbound)

Mobiis Campinas, São Paulo, Brasil

Sobre a Mobiis

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar a inovação na cadeia logística. Resultado da união entre Fretefy e Pathfind, a empresa oferece tecnologias avançadas como TMS, Marketplace de Fretes e APIs, ajudando clientes e parceiros a otimizarem seus processos logísticos com mais inteligência e escala.

Resumo da função

O SDR (Inbound & Outbound) será responsável por atuar na prospecção ativa e no atendimento de leads inbound, qualificando oportunidades para as soluções SaaS da Mobiis. Seu papel é identificar dores, entender o contexto do prospect, gerar interesse e agendar reuniões ou demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas, mantendo um funil de pré-vendas saudável e previsível.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar tanto em outbound (ligações ativas, cadências e prospecção) quanto em inbound (leads vindos de marketing, eventos, formulários e outros canais).
  • Qualificar leads e prospects, entendendo necessidades, desafios, orçamento, perfil decisor e timing.
  • Realizar abordagens consultivas, apresentando de forma objetiva as soluções da Mobiis.
  • Agendar reuniões e demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers / executivos de conta).
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos ao longo do ciclo inicial de pré-vendas.
  • Registrar e atualizar todas as interações no CRM, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing e Vendas para melhoria contínua de scripts, discursos e campanhas.
  • Atingir metas mensais de leads qualificados e reuniões agendadas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales ou funções similares, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e resiliência a objeções.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a processos e metas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e rotina de pré-vendas.
  • Interesse e facilidade para aprender sobre soluções tecnológicas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com modelos de vendas inbound e outbound.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou logística.
  • Conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a metas desafiadoras e ambientes de rápido crescimento.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI

  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We also publish Case Studied, a marketing newsletter with 40,000+ subscribers that breaks down standout campaigns and creative strategies. It’s become a trusted resource for marketers at brands like Shopify, Dr. Squatch, and Magic Spoon—and it’s a core growth engine for Vendry.


The Role:


We’re looking for a Creative Designer to own the visual output across Vendry and Case Studied. This is a hands-on production role—you’ll be responsible for designing the ads that drive our newsletter growth, producing and editing video content, sourcing and managing UGC creators, and designing landing pages and creative assets across the organization.


You’ll work directly with the founder and be the single creative resource for a fast-growing company. That means high ownership, fast feedback loops, and real impact—the ads you design directly drive the pipeline that powers our business.


We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running with Meta ad creative for newsletter growth and expand from there.


Responsibilities:


Ad Creative Production

  • Design 6–8+ static and video ad concepts per month for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) campaigns promoting Case Studied and Vendry.
  • Create ads across proven formats: text-over-video, fake social proof (tweets, DMs, Slack messages), aspirational copy overlays, carousels, and AI-assisted imagery.
  • Iterate on top-performing creatives with fresh hooks, visuals, and B-roll to combat ad fatigue and maintain performance.
  • Stay current on organic social trends (especially TikTok and Instagram) and translate them into paid ad concepts that feel native.

Video & UGC

  • Source, brief, and manage UGC creators—writing scripts, coordinating production, and editing final deliverables.
  • Edit short-form video content for ads, including cuts, text overlays, captions, and sound design.
  • Maintain a roster of vetted creators and continuously identify new talent to keep content fresh.

Landing Pages & Web Design

  • Design and build landing pages for ad campaigns, lead magnets, and conversion funnels (experience with Webflow, Beehiiv, or similar tools preferred).
  • A/B test landing page layouts, headlines, and CTAs to improve conversion rates.

Brand & Organizational Creative

  • Produce creative assets across the company as needed: sales decks, social content, email templates, event materials, and internal documents.
  • Maintain and evolve the visual identity for both Case Studied and Vendry, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint.

Nice to Have: Brand Expansion

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Vendry brand—identifying opportunities to elevate our visual presence, refine our design system, and strengthen brand recognition as we scale.


Qualifications:


Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in creative/graphic design with a strong portfolio of ad creative work.
  • Demonstrated experience designing ads for newsletters, B2B, and/or SaaS companies is a must. We need someone who understands performance creative in these contexts, not just general graphic design.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or After Effects), and/or Canva Pro.
  • Strong video editing skills—comfortable cutting short-form content, adding text overlays, and producing polished ad-ready video.
  • Experience with UGC—sourcing creators, writing briefs/scripts, and managing production workflows.
  • Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practices: aspect ratios, safe zones, hook strategies, ad fatigue cycles, and format requirements.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal). You’ll collaborate daily with a North American team and need to write ad copy, briefs, and creative rationale clearly.
  • Highly organized and self-directed—able to manage your own production calendar, hit deadlines consistently, and work asynchronously across time zones.


Preferred


  • Experience working with landing page builders (Webflow, Beehiiv, Unbounce, or similar).
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics (CTR, CPL, CVR, CPM) and how creative decisions impact them.
  • Experience at a startup, agency, or in a role where you were the sole/primary designer supporting a growing team.
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills.


Why Join Vendry:


This is a rare opportunity to be the creative engine behind a company that’s growing fast and punches well above its weight. You won’t be buried in a design team making minor tweaks to someone else’s vision—you’ll own the entire creative function, work directly with the founder, and see the direct impact of your work on real business results every single week.

We’re a small, collaborative, and fast-moving team that values quality, initiative, and clear communication. If you’re looking for a role where your creative work directly drives growth and you want the autonomy to shape a brand’s visual identity from the ground up, this is it.


How to Apply


Send your portfolio and a brief note about yourself to . We’re especially interested in seeing Meta ad creative, video work, and any newsletter or B2B/SaaS campaign examples. If you’ve managed UGC production, include those examples too.


We move quickly and review portfolios on a rolling basis—if this sounds like your kind of role, don’t wait.

About You

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.

  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .

  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

description:

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

As a RevOps Strategist, you will be the primary client-facing partner for several of our SaaS clients. You’ll work closely with the Founder/CEO during your first 3–6 months, joining calls together and learning our methodology. Over time, you will take ownership of the client relationship—shaping their RevOps strategy, managing ongoing deliverables, and guiding a team of RevOps Analysts on execution.


This role blends:

  • Client strategy & communication
  • RevOps problem-solving & system architecture
  • Hands-on tool knowledge (especially HubSpot)
  • Scoping, prioritizing, and quality-checking technical work


This is not a “ticket-taker” role. You’ll be a strategic partner, trusted advisor, and cross-functional operator helping early- and growth-stage SaaS companies scale their go-to-market operations.


What You’ll Do


RevOps Strategy

  • Partner with clients to build and evolve their RevOps strategy across the full funnel (Marketing, Sales, CS).
  • Proactively identify gaps, opportunities, and process improvements.
  • Translate business goals into concrete RevOps initiatives and technical requirements.
  • Provide perspective on best practices across areas such as:
  • Lead flow design
  • Pipeline management
  • Process automation & workflow optimization
  • CRM governance
  • GTM integrations
  • Reporting & analytics
  • AI implementation for GTM workflows


Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for 3–6 clients.
  • Run weekly/bi-weekly client meetings, deliver updates, and document decisions.
  • Communicate proactively via Slack and email with clarity, professionalism, and consistency.
  • Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders (Marketing, Sales, RevOps, CS).


Implementation Leadership & Quality Assurance

  • Work with our RevOps Analysts to scope, prioritize, and assign technical work.
  • Review deliverables for accuracy, strategy alignment, and data integrity.
  • Jump into tools directly (especially HubSpot) when needed to troubleshoot or validate.
  • Ensure high-quality execution that reflects Floodlight Growth standards.


About You

You are a hybrid: part RevOps strategist, part systems thinker, part client partner. You’re comfortable both solving a strategic GTM problem and advising on how to execute it in HubSpot.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on RevOps or Marketing/Sales Ops experience.
  • Advanced HubSpot experience (CRM, workflows, custom objects, lead routing, reporting).
  • Experience with Salesforce, Clay, sales engagement tools, and GTM integrations strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience working across the full revenue funnel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable.
  • Ability to turn a business conversation into clear technical requirements.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience in consulting, client services, or agency environments.
  • Familiarity with automation platforms (Zapier, n8n, Workato).
  • Strong analytical skills (e.g., Looker, Snowflake, HubSpot reporting).

title: Data Engineer
description:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Give a Shit.”


Senior Data Engineer


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

Fluência em inglês

Experiência comprovada em SQL – incluindo junções, agregações, funções de janela e ajuste de desempenho

Familiaridade com os serviços de dados da AWS (por exemplo, EMR, S3, Glue)

The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.

Diferenciais

title: Graphic Designer
description:

EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.

  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms

  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication

  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment

Job Title: Application Support Engineer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Role Description: The Application Support Engineer is responsible for administering and supporting the ticketing system, as well as providing operational support, maintenance, and lifecycle management for both SaaS (vendor-managed) and self-managed enterprise applications. This role ensures applications are secure, available, performant, and compliant, while serving as a key coordination point between vendors, internal infrastructure teams, InfoSec, and business stakeholders.

Mandatory Experience: SaaS-Ticketing system, Atlassian suite, Jira. also have experience managing on-premise applications running on windows or Linux platforms that require patch and update deployment. The most important qualities are independence and a strong willingness to learn.


Job Experience Requirements:

  • 3–7 years of experience supporting the ticketing system and enterprise applications across SaaS and self-managed models.
  • Hands-on experience with application deployments, patching, and maintenance for self-managed systems.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS operating models, vendor support, and SLA management.
  • Experience with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem, request management).
  • Hands-on experience in administering and supporting ticketing systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot across applications, infrastructure, and integration layers.
  • Strong communication skills to work with vendors and cross-functional IT teams.
  • Experience supporting business-critical or regulated applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid environments.
  • Knowledge of IAM, observability, and security controls.

Job Responsibilities:

Self-Managed Application Support

  • Perform application maintenance for self-managed applications, including deployment of application updates, patches, and fixes.
  • Support production and non-production environments (dev, test, staging, prod).
  • Execute deployments following approved change management (CAB) processes.
  • Monitor application health, availability, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve L2/L3 issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Cloud Infrastructure, IAM, and InfoSec teams for changes and remediation.

SaaS (Managed Service) Application Support

  • Act as the primary IT point of contact for SaaS applications managed by external vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support escalations, and SLA adherence.
  • Coordinate SaaS releases, upgrades, and vendor-led changes, including impact assessment and business communications.
  • Validate vendor patching, security updates, and release notes for enterprise impact.
  • Support SaaS configuration changes, user provisioning, role management, and integrations.
  • Partner with InfoSec and Compliance to support risk assessments, audits, and vendor reviews.

Incident, Request & Service Management

  • Provide L2/L3 support for incidents and service requests across SaaS and self-managed applications.
  • Collaborate with GSD / Client Services for L1 support and escalation workflows.
  • Ensure timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and proper ticket documentation.

Security, Compliance & Risk

  • Support application patching and vulnerability remediation (self-managed) and validation (SaaS).
  • Ensure applications align with IAM, data protection, and enterprise security standards.
  • Support audit, SOX, GxP, and compliance activities by providing operational evidence.

Governance, Documentation & Lifecycle Management

  • Maintain application documentation, runbooks, and support models.
  • Participate in application onboarding, upgrades, renewals, and decommissioning.
  • Support application rationalization and standardization initiatives.

title: Python Developer with GE Proficy
description:
Nosso cliente está iniciando uma iniciativa transformadora para modernizar nossa infraestrutura de IoT , que suporta nosso portfólio diversificado de ativos de geração de energia — incluindo sistemas solares, eólicos e de armazenamento por baterias.

Este projeto substituirá nosso sistema atual, CEWIS (customizado internamente), por soluções prontas de mercado (off-the-shelf), integrando plataformas avançadas como AWS , GE Proficy , Databricks e ServiceNow .

O objetivo é criar um ecossistema coeso e escalável que aumente a eficiência operacional e a integridade dos dados.

Ao adotar essas novas tecnologias, buscamos ganhar escala mais rapidamente e obter suporte mais robusto, possibilitando decisões mais rápidas e orientadas por dados.

Nossa arquitetura combina, de maneira integrada:

  • coleta de dados em edge (em campo),
  • processamento em nuvem,
  • e análises avançadas,

colocando-nos na vanguarda das inovações no setor de energia renovável.

Estamos buscando uma equipe altamente qualificada e motivada de Business Analysis e Quality Assurance (BA/QA) para atuação por contrato .

Essa equipe será responsável por:

  • conduzir análises detalhadas de negócio para apoiar decisões estratégicas,
  • garantir a qualidade e confiabilidade dos sistemas de software,
  • realizar testes completos e validações.

Este Statement of Work (SOW) descreve as principais responsabilidades, qualificações e expectativas para esta equipe.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Configurar e dar suporte ao GE Proficy Historian na nuvem AWS.
  • Configurar collectors e criar tags nos formatos:
  • raw (bruto)
  • calculated (calculado)
  • writeback (leitura/gravação)
  • Desenvolver scripts em Python para cálculos e conversões de tags.
  • Habilitar aplicações downstream para consumo de dados.
  • Monitorar, solucionar problemas e dar suporte ao sistema historian.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes.   • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

Junte-se a nós!

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

  • Exposure to international gaming payments and digital asset liquidity management.
  • Performance-oriented, data-driven working environment.

title: High-Stakes Poker Specialist
